title: The Light of the World
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: John was one of Jesus’s best friends. He wrote a book about Jesus. It begins, “In the beginning was the Word.”
The Word is a name for Jesus. Our words show what is in our hearts. Jesus shows us Heavenly Father’s heart.
Before the world was made, Jesus was with Heavenly Father. Jesus helped Him make everything: the stars, the sea, and the trees.
p2: John wrote that Jesus is like a light. When it is dark, a light shows the way. Jesus’s light shines in the dark.
Then Jesus came to earth with a real body, just like yours. He lived with people, full of kindness and truth. Tonight, when your light goes off, whisper, “Jesus is my light.”
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
